escena.titulo: The Great Acceleration and the Anthropocene

visual.pie: The Anthropocene: human impact at planetary scale

turnos.t: Unit 1.3. Fossil fuels powered the Industrial Revolution from the mid-1700s. Then, around 1950, human activity and Earth-system change surged together. Steffen and colleagues, in 2015, tracked 12 socio-economic and 12 Earth-system indicators, and all of them bend sharply upwards around 1950. That's the Great Acceleration.
And that's why people talk about the Anthropocene.
